management_reference.management: Almost all guidelines recommend alpha-1 blockers (and 5-alpha reductase inhibitors) as drug treatment.

management_reference.management: Combination therapy with an alpha-1 blocker and a 5-alpha reductase inhibitor is the most uniformly recommended combination.
